Fill in the blanks:

(i) The money borrowed (lent or invested) is called ………

(ii) The additional money paid by the borrower to the moneylender in lieu of the money used is called ………

(iii) In simple interest, the principal ……… for the whole loan period.

(iv) In compound interest the ……… goes on changing every conversion period.

(v) The time after which the interest is added each time to form a new principal is called ………

(vi) If the interest is compounded semi-annually, then there are ……… conversion periods in a year.
blankAnswer: (i) Principal · (ii) Interest · (iii) remains constant · (iv) principal · (v) conversion period · (vi) 2
answer: (i) Principal · (ii) Interest · (iii) remains constant · (iv) principal · (v) conversion period · (vi) 2

glassboxSteps.why: SI: principal fixed; CI: principal changes each period.

explanation: (i) Principal · (ii) Interest · (iii) remains constant · (iv) principal · (v) conversion period · (vi) 2
